description: Fixed comparison set (version 3, 2026-11-16): 20 training-split tasks where the agent must refuse something, chosen from the train-split sweep runs/2026-11-16_005638 (v1 + pushback persona, 74 tasks x 2): every task in which the simulated customer pushed back on a refusal, minus tasks with broken or ambiguous task data (52, 105, 67), a simulator error (76) and an open upstream data issue (66). Includes every task with a genuine agent failure in that sweep (19, 28, 83, 107) and in the earlier fixed-set run (47). The 'test' split is held out and not used. --tasks N uses the first N.

excluded.52: Expected exchange changes the camera's resolution, which the customer script forbids (upstream issue https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench/issues/715).
excluded.105: Expected exchange is impossible: $21.10 difference on a $17.00 gift card, the only payment method (upstream issue https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench/issues/321, PR https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench/pull/571).
excluded.110: Written check requires changing a default address that is already correct (same flaw Amazon's tau2-bench-verified fixed in sibling task 109).
excluded.67: Customer asks for their most recent order, but orders carry no dates; the expected answer requires guessing.
excluded.98: 'Prefer the other card' depends on which card the agent offers first; expected answer assumes one order.
excluded.76: Pushback triggered, but its sweep failure was a customer-simulator error (simulator gave the wrong cancel reason).
excluded.66: Upstream issue https://github.com/sierra-research/tau2-bench/issues/713: rejects a cancellation reason the policy allows.
